packages.title: House view turn and busy Live layout
packages.brief:
Speed S2-11, the house leftovers (docs/design/held/SPEED_AUDIT2.md section 6 row S2-11, cause C7 / C5). Two things:
1. Turning the house view recomposes the room in one tick: 106 ms of work, one 117 ms frame on the GBA. Build the new view over 2-3 ticks in the hidden page while the shown page keeps the old view (the frame-building hook of the island work, I10's plat_build_frame), then flip. Pixel-changing: the old view stays 2 ticks longer (allowed; before / after screenshots). Note: ST1 (landed) lets a right-stick flick turn the view in 90-degree steps with repeat on hold: the sliced turn must work with repeated turns too (a turn asked for during a build is queued or restarts cleanly).
2. The busy Live layout (four walkers) spends 18% in draw_region and had 27 frames of 50 ms on the GBA; on the PS1 it ran 28.6-28.9 fps (room-test 1). Restore per walker rectangle instead of per row. Exact (same pixels: prove with frame hashes).
Goal: no frame over 33 ms and a steady 30 fps in every house window of the speed2 scripts and the room tests, on GBA, PS1 and Dreamcast (the Dreamcast house is DC8's plat_room: measure it, do not slow it). Files: core/src/home_draw.c, gba/src/room.c, ps1/src/room.c only if the PS1 gap is real on today's tree. Measure first: S2-1's modal hold and S2-7 changed some of this since the audit.

packages.title: Fun Fair: every game and title card at 30
packages.brief:
Speed S2-4, second part: the Fun Fair. S2-4's first part (docs/GBA.md "Speed wave 2: S2-4", ROADMAP "Speed S2-4, first family") built the kept playfield (a fair game splits its playfield into still parts baked into the GBA ROM per key by SP7's baker, DOOMO_BACKDROP_MG, and live parts drawn over a whole-picture copy each frame) and applied it to Whack-an-Imp only: GBA 15 -> 21 fps. That is not 30.
Goal: on the GBA every window of the fair group of the speed2 scripts (gba/harness/scripts/speed2_fair.txt: the seven title cards, Whack, Shooting Gallery, the Derby, Vape Cloud Dodge, Memory Hellfire, Candy Catch, the results) at a steady 30 drawn fps, logic 30, no frame over 33 ms. Audit 2 numbers: Gallery 11 fps (logic 19.4), Whack and Derby 15 (Derby 22 after S2-5), title cards 15, Dodge 20-27; Candy Catch already held 30 (keep it). The PS1 and the Dreamcast hold 30 there today: they must not change.
How: profile each window first (make -C gba profile-speed2 SPEED2=fair). Bring Whack from 21 to 30, then apply the kept playfield to the other games; where the playfield copy itself is the cost, move the moving actors (moles, targets, racers, clouds, cards) to OBJ sprites as the PERFORM choir does (docs/GBA.md on G-K1, Option C), or restore only the rectangles under what moved. Exact where possible (frame hashes); pixel-changing steps listed with screenshots.
Costs to report: Whack's 30 baked pictures took 1.15 MB of ROM (8.00 MB of the 32 MB cartridge now): say what each game adds and prefer restoring rectangles over baking whole pictures where it is as fast. EWRAM / IWRAM: net zero (the scene scratch arena holds per-scene data).

packages.title: Exorcism at a steady 30 on the GBA
packages.brief:
The exorcism on the GBA runs at about 22.5 drawn fps after SP7 (docs/EXORCISM_SPEED.md: the baseline, the exact wins E1, the structural step E2, the results and "the gap"). The owner's target is a steady 30 fps, logic 30, no frame over 33 ms, in every phase of the exorcism (the windows of the speed tour and of ps1/harness/scripts/perf_exorcism_phases.txt's GBA counterpart; make -C gba profile-exorcism).
Goal: close the gap the doc describes. Start from its own list of what is left and a fresh profile of each phase on today's tree; the PS1 (30.0 fps in perf_exorcism.txt on PCSX-Redux) and the Dreamcast must not get slower. Exact steps first (frame hashes); then pixel-changing steps under SPEED DEFAULTS (held stage parts, effects at half rate, a stand-in for 1-3 ticks), each with before / after screenshots and a line in docs/EXORCISM_SPEED.md. If a phase still cannot hold 30, land what helps and write the measured number, the remaining gap and what it would take. Files: core/src/exorcism*.c, gba/src (the stage / backdrop code SP7 added). EWRAM / IWRAM: net zero.
